import unittest
from roman import RomanConverter

class TestRomanConverter(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_to_roman(self):
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.to_roman(1), "I")
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.to_roman(4), "IV")
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.to_roman(9), "IX")
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.to_roman(58), "LVIII")
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.to_roman(1994), "MCMXCIV")

    def test_from_roman(self):
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.from_roman("I"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.from_roman("IV"), 4)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.from_roman("IX"), 9)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.from_roman("LVIII"), 58)
        self.assertEqual(RomanConverter.from_roman("MCMXCIV"), 1994)

    def test_invalid_inputs(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.to_roman(0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.to_roman(4000)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.from_roman("IIII")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            RomanConverter.from_roman("ABC")

EOF
